title: The world's great rivers and mountains
examples: Which river is the longest in the world?
Can you tell me about the Andes Mountains?
What are some famous rivers and mountains?

explain.say: Today we say about some big rivers and mountains.

draw.text: The world's great rivers and mountains

explain.say: The Nile River is a very long river in Africa.
The Amazon River is a huge river in South America.
The Yangtze River is a major river in China.
The Andes Mountains are a long mountain range in South America.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level.

faq.q: Which river is the longest in the world?
faq.a: Some sources say the Nile River is the longest river. Others sometimes name the Amazon River as the longest.

faq.q: Are all the mountains in the world so tall?
faq.a: No, mountains come in different sizes and heights. Some are very tall, and some are smaller hills.

faq.q: Where are the Andes Mountains located?
faq.a: The Andes Mountains are a long chain found in South America. They run along the western side of the continent.
asks: Where can I find the Andes?

faq.q: Do all these rivers flow to the sea?
faq.a: Most large rivers do flow into an ocean or a sea. This is how they empty out their water.
asks: Do rivers end in the sea?

faq.q: Is Mount Everest always the highest point?
faq.a: Mount Everest is famous for being one of the world's highest peaks. Its height is measured above sea level.
asks: How do we measure mountain height?

facts: The Nile River is located in Africa.
The Amazon River is in South America.
The Yangtze River is found in China.
The Andes Mountains are a major range in South America.
Mount Everest is known for its great height.

quiz.say: Which river is located in Africa?
quiz.why: The Nile River is a well-known river system found in Africa.

wrong.0: The Yangtze River is located in China, which is in Asia.
wrong.1: Everest is a mountain, not a river.
wrong.3: The Amazon River is found in South America, not Africa.

quiz.say: Which mountain range is in South America?
quiz.why: The Andes Mountains form a long chain along the western edge of South America.

wrong.0: Mount Everest is a single peak, not a long range.
wrong.2: The Nile is a river, not a mountain range.
wrong.3: The Amazon is a river, not a mountain range.

quiz.say: If you are studying Asian geography, which mountain is highest?
quiz.why: Mount Everest is recognized as one of the world's highest peaks in Asia.

wrong.0: The Andes Mountains are a range, and while high, Everest is higher.
wrong.1: The Nile is a river and does not have a height measurement like a mountain.
wrong.2: The Amazon is a river and does not have a height measurement like a mountain.
